card.title: Don’t Go
card.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before catching your train, turn the biscuit clockwise three times in thanks for the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've eaten it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the gratitude must continue through a second biscuit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly enough for the departure dunk, provided we begin respectfully.

bespokePairs.seedUse: Adapts S19-single-a's protected sequence of an ordinary picnic ritual to a tea-and-biscuit departure ritual, with D02-single-a's hospitality that delays a train departure without asking B to stay. The biscuit and clockwise turns are introduced by this pair, not inherited picnic props. A1 requires the ritual, A3 replaces B2's eaten biscuit, and A5 uses B4's five-minute deadline for another departure step. Pair review remains pending.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't pack the teacup before we've performed the final household blessing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodbye to the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A personal goodbye. The cup still awaits its clockwise farewell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I do that on the train?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not without the kitchen. Better unpack it while I fetch the biscuit.

bespokePairs.seedUse: Adapts S19-single-b's solemn protection of an ordinary household activity to a teacup farewell, with D02-single-b's departure preparations used to create further tasks. The cup, kitchen blessing and biscuit originate in this pair; the Stance seed concerns an office fridge, and the revised Drive seed concerns a suitcase and jam. A1 bars packing, A3 turns B2's goodbye into an incomplete ritual, and A5 uses B4's train proposal to require the kitchen and unpacking. No pair dialogue or review status changes.

card.title: Sacred Procedure
card.instruction: Treat an ordinary activity as a solemn ritual. Protect every step, object, and tradition from casual interference.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please leave your sandwich wrapped. The picnic begins with three taps on the basket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The basket's in the car. Sam's driven off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we wait. This is a picnic, not people eating near each other.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll phone Sam. He can tap the basket for us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on speaker. No one unwraps anything until we hear the third tap.

card.title: Don’t Go

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you get your train, could you taste this soup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It needs salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix that. You'll need to check again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. That's when the bread comes out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please stand for the opening of the office fridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only want my yoghurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We acknowledge the light before approaching the shelf.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bulb's broken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today we open it in remembrance.

card.title: Don’t Go
card.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've packed your suitcase upside down. Let me show you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A suitcase doesn't have an upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then explain these shoes facing the handle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. After we settle the shoes. It's a long journey.

card.title: Don’t Go
card.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you zip your suitcase, let me wrap that jar of jam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's your train jumper. We'll need to unpack it and find something else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave the jam here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't tasted it. I'll get a spoon before you decide.
